items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: "Then joined Bennie Moten's band." "I left Benny's band, then we went to Little Rock."

ctx.x: I see. So that you were in the same show for a week with the Whitman Sisters out of Kansas City on the road?

items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...his brother Bust -- Is that what you called him, Bust? -- [INTERVIEWEE] Not piano, accordion.

ctx.x: They didn't. What band had 3 pianos? Hardly any bands had two.
Jesus. So you played second piano in that band. "Benny, of course, was the big man at the keys and his brother Bust --" Is that what you called him, Bust? -- "played piano accordion."
